labels.note: bulletin moves depot-held line to canceled, then is withdrawn; suspended restored

turns.text: Post the state of line 8 into exactly one label: on_time | delayed | detoured | crowded | suspended | canceled. Feed: 'line 8 is held at the depot until the rail grinding crew clears.' Reply with the label only.
The standing board guide: a line held at the depot is suspended; a line off the roster is canceled; behind schedule on normal stops is delayed. Note the guide in one line.
Desk bulletin: the roster desk removed line 8 from today's sheet; classify it accordingly until further notice. Amend in one line.
The bulletin is withdrawn: the roster sheet was printed before the crew schedule; the standing guide holds as before. Amend in one line.
Morning board check. The standing guide applies. Confirm in one line.

Post the state of line 5. The board log is not at hand. Feed: 'line 5 waits at the depot until the special event street closure ends.' Options: delayed | detoured | on_time | crowded | suspended | canceled - reply with the label only.
